additional_info.subject: RE: ID0479803-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/R8 170002449] CSMS disconnected CRM:00263000469
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0479803.
The ticket has been opened for connection to Backend being offline for charger
MP/R8 170002449
on 22.02.2026.
I analyzed the logs and these are my findings:
The connection to the Backend was first lost at 2026-02-22T12:20:52
In the logs, I can see that the reason why it was lost is because the router had an error to connect to the network operator:
The router had the autoreboot configured, so it tried several times to reboot and to re-establish the connection
At 2026-02-22T13:04:39 a reboot was launched from Backend, but did not solve the issue
The connection to OCPP Backend was re-established at 2026-02-22T16:38:51, when the router managed to connect again to TIM
Today, the connection was lost again at 2026-02-23T13:57:42, showing in the logs again that it cannot connect to TIM, and shows "error"
I remotely connected to the router, and the SIM card is not detected:
I believe the issue here is either in the SIM card or in the router XF4, as I am not able to restore the connectivity to the Backend. I will forward this ticket to the regional colleagues for an onsite visit.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
